3077079169.annotation: 1. e4 - Open with some gun utility. We'll develop this piece into a real threat soon.

2064029594.annotation: 3. d3 - Develops our High-Velocity rounds into extra spirit + opening gun damage, use this to set up a double bishop nuke

1672893796.annotation: Gun-heavy lane? Grab this early and upgrade it to Weapon Shielding at your earliest convenience.

2829638276.annotation: (Optional) 2. Ke2 - Lane sustain and a solid 800 green to get to that early spike. You can replace this with other 800s from the Greens section if you prefer/aren't being harassed.

1644605047.annotation: Buy it if you are going to buy Indomitable

2603935618.annotation: 8. d4 - Heal cut is easy to spread on Solomon and let's face it, most of your teammates aren't buying any.

2081037738.annotation: 12. Bg2 - More shred to stack with your bishops for even more damage.

1150006784.annotation: PLEASE READ DESCRIPTION OF THE BUILD. To use this, firstly use the buff to spawn bishop, then just let the buff be, it will increase 1st ability damage until it ended. It works very stange...

3140772621.annotation: Brainless anti-gun. Useful into sustained gun damage characters (e.g. Rat King)

2163598980.annotation: (Optional) 17. Bf1 - Most teams are going to hit you with more spirit than anything, replace this with a different 3200 if needed.

1144549437.annotation: Gives 4.8k gun invest and bonuses to our spirit damage

4075861416.annotation: 11. g3 - Even more spirit shred and your gun spike means you can do even more damage. Spam headshots on tanks late game for maximum throughput.

951866250.annotation: You can be targeted by someone, but Unstob is too much for you, super good if you took reactive before

1955841979.annotation: 23. b4 - Even more spirit resist + debuff resist (in case you're being silenced to prevent 2 usage)

2152872419.annotation: Picking up this item locks you into a playstyle where you stay far away from the fight. This is a solid Spirit Rend alternative and pairs best with Magic Carpet and other movement items.

1102081447.annotation: 16. Nbd2 - Pin all their pawns in place by reapplying this constantly.

3731635960.annotation: In case your 2 dispel isn't enough (e.g. Silence), this is a second option.

3977876567.annotation: Probably the best Opening Rounds replacement - solves the ammo and fire rate problem all at once.

4104549924.annotation: Extra fire rate, pair with Titanic Magazine to match Opening Rounds' damage.

395867183.annotation: This is a pretty insane damage item late game. Pair this with Boundless Spirit for maximum damage.

1439347412.annotation: Чисто для того что бы размениваться на лайне в плюс, продайте если нет слотов первым

1925087134.annotation: Very good against gun heroes, also you can upgrade your 3rd ability versus them!

112198670.annotation: CONSIDER ALL OTHER SHIELDINGS HERE TOO. Good vs super heavy spirit lane

1414025773.annotation: In case your 2 invuln isn't enough, this is a second option.

865958998.annotation: Allows for an incredibly stupid (and fun) invisible rook -> queen combo for picks in the late game (especially good with Refresher + Transcendent!)

2947183272.annotation: NERFED. Only if you got Mys.Regen and need HEAVY survivability

2221211450.annotation: We cast many abilities pretty often AND our bullets scale with spirit, BUT only if got gun spike before.

2226497419.annotation: Gives so many things, but only with spellslinger.

2356412290.annotation: If you don't feel confident in your dash jumps and don't like Opening Rounds grab this with Swift Striker.

690458959.annotation: Yes, our damage per 1 bullet is good, BUT we get value from long fights and not bursts, even Sharpshooter is better

1219329868.annotation: 6. f4 - Pop this before slamming your combo on enemies. Previously you'd rely on extra squares for damage, but now we simply go for extra shred and direct impacts.

3028234315.annotation: 20. Qd3 - This is a strong anti-spirit item AND improves your cooldowns on your combo and sustain abilities.

4204808176.annotation: Melee heavy lane? Get this for a chance to turn around and pick up a kill or two on that Billy/Abrams

3399065363.annotation: If you're planning on going speed later (or want a cheeky Trophy Collector) you can grab this over Extra Regen in a passive lane.

2447176615.annotation: Can be useful against a ton of slows.

805079544.annotation: Early anti-gun option. You kind of struggle against gun damage, can replace Enchanter's with this.

3585132399.annotation: Pure HP option, good if you go jungling.

1250307611.annotation: One of the best anti-gun items in the game, slowing fire rate is insanely powerful against most gun carries (and some spirit carries too)

3294954488.annotation: This is strictly worse than Greater Expansion, but if you find yourself wanting to maintain your shred potential while transitioning to a gun heavy build this is a decent pickup. Imbue on 1.

4053935515.annotation: Very good healing utility for Gun Solomon and extra speed to get out of dangerous spots. Works well with Transcendent Cooldown.

3791587546.annotation: Your build-up on shots is quite high, so this can be a useful pickup if you want to play a more close-range, aggressive style. Use this to set up your Rooks and Bishops.

3696726732.annotation: Similar to Weighted, you build up this proc insanely fast and the scaling is quite good with all of your spirit investment. Consider this as a mid-game anti-heal option in a hybrid damage build.

1113837674.annotation: Solomon's very fast buildup allows him to proc this quickly in fights AND this helps you shut down enemy spirit carries. Get this into an all-spirit lineup for your gun/hybrid build.

3331811235.annotation: Can be buyed instead of opening rounds

2462046703.annotation: Весь урон идет от спирита и яичко можно дерать вплоть до 3к, но если игра активная продать как можно раньше (минимум 1200)
